    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Live API - WebSockets API reference<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>
  

  <devsite-toc class="devsite-nav"
    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    
<p></p>































<aside class="preview"><strong>Preview:</strong><span> The Live API is in preview.</span></aside>
<p>The Live API is a stateful API
that uses <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WebSocket">WebSockets</a>.
In this section, you&#39;ll find additional details regarding the WebSockets API.</p>

<h2 id="sessions" data-text="Sessions" tabindex="-1">Sessions</h2>

<p>A WebSocket connection establishes a session between the client and the Gemini
server. After a client initiates a new connection the session can exchange
messages with the server to:</p>

<ul>
<li>Send text, audio, or video to the Gemini server.</li>
<li>Receive audio, text, or function call requests from the Gemini server.</li>
</ul>

<h3 id="websocket-connection" data-text="WebSocket connection" tabindex="-1">WebSocket connection</h3>

<p>To start a session, connect to this websocket endpoint:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Text only" syntax-guessed><code translate="no" dir="ltr">wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContent
</code></pre></devsite-code><aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> The URL is for version <code translate="no" dir="ltr">v1beta</code>.</span></aside>
<h3 id="session-configuration" data-text="Session configuration" tabindex="-1">Session configuration</h3>

<p>The initial message sent after establishing the WebSocket connection sets the
session configuration, which includes the model, generation parameters, system
instructions, and tools.</p>

<p>You cannot update the configuration while the connection is open. However, you
can change the configuration parameters, except the model, when pausing and
resuming via the <a href="#BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.SessionResumptionConfig.BidiGenerateContentSetup.session_resumption">session resumption mechanism</a>.</p>

<p>See the following example configuration. Note that the name casing in SDKs may
vary. You can look up the <a href="https://github.com/googleapis/python-genai/blob/main/google/genai/types.py">Python SDK configuration options here</a>.</p>

<div></div><devsite-code><pre suppresswarning translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code class="prettyprint lang-json" translate="no" dir="ltr">
{
  "model": string,
  "generationConfig": {
    "candidateCount": integer,
    "maxOutputTokens": integer,
    "temperature": number,
    "topP": number,
    "topK": integer,
    "presencePenalty": number,
    "frequencyPenalty": number,
    "responseModalities": [string],
    "speechConfig": object,
    "mediaResolution": object,
    "translationConfig": object
  },
  "systemInstruction": string,
  "tools": [object]
}
</code></pre></devsite-code>

<p>For more information on the API field, see <a href="/api/generate-content#v1beta.GenerationConfig">generationConfig</a>.</p>

<h2 id="send-messages" data-text="Send messages" tabindex="-1">Send messages</h2>

<p>To exchange messages over the WebSocket connection, the client must send a JSON
object over an open WebSocket connection. The JSON object must have
<strong>exactly one</strong> of the fields from the following object set:</p>

<div></div><devsite-code><pre suppresswarning translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code class="prettyprint lang-json" translate="no" dir="ltr">
{
  "setup": BidiGenerateContentSetup,
  "clientContent": BidiGenerateContentClientContent,
  "realtimeInput": BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput,
  "toolResponse": BidiGenerateContentToolResponse
}
</code></pre></devsite-code>

<h3 id="client-messages" data-text="Supported client messages" tabindex="-1">Supported client messages</h3>

<p>See the supported client messages in the following table:</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Message</th>
<th>Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentSetup</code></td>
<td>Session configuration to be sent in the first message</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentClientContent</code></td>
<td>Incremental content update of the current conversation delivered from the client</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput</code></td>
<td>Real time audio, video, or text input</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentToolResponse</code></td>
<td>Response to a <code translate="no" dir="ltr">ToolCallMessage</code> received from the server</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h2 id="receive-messages" data-text="Receive messages" tabindex="-1">Receive messages</h2>

<p>To receive messages from Gemini, listen for the WebSocket &#39;message&#39; event,
and then parse the result according to the definition of the
supported server messages.</p>

<p>See the following:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">with</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">aio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">live</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">connect</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'...'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">as</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">send</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'Hello world!'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">end_of_turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">for</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">message</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">in</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">receive</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">():</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">message</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Server messages may have a <a href="#UsageMetadata"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">usageMetadata</code></a> field but will
otherwise include <strong>exactly one</strong> of the other fields from the
<a href="#BidiGenerateContentServerMessage"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentServerMessage</code></a>
message. (The <code translate="no" dir="ltr">messageType</code> union is not expressed in JSON so the field will
appear at the top-level of the message.)</p>

<h2 id="messages" data-text="Messages and events" tabindex="-1">Messages and events</h2>

<section id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.ActivityEnd">
  <h3 id="activityend" data-text="ActivityEnd" tabindex="-1">ActivityEnd</h3>
  <p>This type has no fields.</p>
  <section id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.ActivityEnd.description">
    <p>Marks the end of user activity.</p>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="RealtimeInputConfig.ActivityHandling">
  <h3 id="activityhandling" data-text="ActivityHandling" tabindex="-1">ActivityHandling</h3>

  <section id="RealtimeInputConfig.ActivityHandling.description">
    <p>The different ways of handling user activity.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="RealtimeInputConfig.ActivityHandling.ENUM_VALUES">
    <table class="constants responsive fixed" id="RealtimeInputConfig.ActivityHandling.ENUM_VALUES-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Enums</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.ActivityHandling.ENUM_VALUES.RealtimeInputConfig.ActivityHandling.ACTIVITY_HANDLING_UNSPECIFIED">
          <td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">ACTIVITY_HANDLING_UNSPECIFIED</code></td>
          <td>If unspecified, the default behavior is <code translate="no" dir="ltr">START_OF_ACTIVITY_INTERRUPTS</code>.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.ActivityHandling.ENUM_VALUES.RealtimeInputConfig.ActivityHandling.START_OF_ACTIVITY_INTERRUPTS">
          <td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">START_OF_ACTIVITY_INTERRUPTS</code></td>
          <td>If true, start of activity will interrupt the model's response (also called "barge in"). The model's current response will be cut-off in the moment of the interruption. This is the default behavior.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.ActivityHandling.ENUM_VALUES.RealtimeInputConfig.ActivityHandling.NO_INTERRUPTION">
          <td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">NO_INTERRUPTION</code></td>
          <td>The model's response will not be interrupted.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.ActivityStart">
  <h3 id="activitystart" data-text="ActivityStart" tabindex="-1">ActivityStart</h3>
  <p>This type has no fields.</p>
  <section id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.ActivityStart.description">
    <p>Marks the start of user activity.</p>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="AudioTranscriptionConfig">
  <h3 id="audiotranscriptionconfig" data-text="AudioTranscriptionConfig" tabindex="-1">AudioTranscriptionConfig</h3>

  <section id="AudioTranscriptionConfig.description">
    <p>The audio transcription configuration.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="AudioTranscriptionConfig.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="AudioTranscriptionConfig.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="AudioTranscriptionConfig.FIELDS.repeated.string.AudioTranscriptionConfig.language_codes">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">languageCodes[]</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></p>
            <p>Optional. BCP-47 language codes providing hints about the languages present in the audio. If omitted or empty, defaults to automatic language detection.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AudioTranscriptionConfig.FIELDS.repeated.string.AudioTranscriptionConfig.custom_vocabulary">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">customVocabulary[]</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></p>
            <p>Optional. A list of custom vocabulary phrases to bias the speech recognition model toward recognizing specific terms (product names, proper nouns, jargon).</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AudioTranscriptionConfig.FIELDS.bool.AudioTranscriptionConfig.word_timestamp">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">wordTimestamp</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Optional. Configures word-level timestamp generation.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AudioTranscriptionConfig.FIELDS.bool.AudioTranscriptionConfig.diarization">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">diarization</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Optional. Configures speaker diarization.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AudioTranscriptionConfig.FIELDS.AudioTranscriptionConfig.Mode.AudioTranscriptionConfig.mode">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">mode</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#AudioTranscriptionConfig.Mode">Mode</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Configures transcription mode. Supported values: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">VERBATIM</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">SMART</code>. If unspecified, defaults to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">VERBATIM</code> transcription. In <code translate="no" dir="ltr">SMART</code> mode, the model performs disfluency removal (eliminating filler words, repetitions, and false starts), light grammatical cleanup, automatic formatting (paragraphs, bullet points, numbered lists), and minor user edits (inline self-corrections). Timestamps and diarization are incompatible with mode <code translate="no" dir="ltr">SMART</code>.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection">
  <h3 id="automaticactivitydetection" data-text="AutomaticActivityDetection" tabindex="-1">AutomaticActivityDetection</h3>

  <section id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.description">
    <p>Configures automatic detection of activity.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.FIELDS.bool.RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.disabled">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">disabled</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Optional. If enabled (the default), detected voice and text input count as activity. If disabled, the client must send activity signals.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.FIELDS.RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity.RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.start_of_speech_sensitivity">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">startOfSpeechSensitivity</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity">StartSensitivity</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Determines how likely speech is to be detected.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.FIELDS.int32.RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.prefix_padding_ms">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">prefixPaddingMs</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">int32</code></p>
            <p>Optional. The required duration of detected speech before start-of-speech is committed. The lower this value, the more sensitive the start-of-speech detection is and shorter speech can be recognized. However, this also increases the probability of false positives.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.FIELDS.RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.EndSensitivity.RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.end_of_speech_sensitivity">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">endOfSpeechSensitivity</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.EndSensitivity">EndSensitivity</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Determines how likely detected speech is ended.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.FIELDS.int32.RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.silence_duration_ms">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">silenceDurationMs</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">int32</code></p>
            <p>Optional. The required duration of detected non-speech (e.g. silence) before end-of-speech is committed. The larger this value, the longer speech gaps can be without interrupting the user's activity but this will increase the model's latency.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="BidiGenerateContentClientContent">
  <h3 id="bidigeneratecontentclientcontent" data-text="BidiGenerateContentClientContent" tabindex="-1">BidiGenerateContentClientContent</h3>

  <section id="BidiGenerateContentClientContent.description">
    <p>Incremental update of the current conversation delivered from the client. All of the content here is unconditionally appended to the conversation history and used as part of the prompt to the model to generate content.</p><p>A message here will interrupt any current model generation.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="BidiGenerateContentClientContent.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="BidiGenerateContentClientContent.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentClientContent.FIELDS.repeated.Content.BidiGenerateContentClientContent.turns">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">turns[]</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#Content">Content</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. The content appended to the current conversation with the model.</p><p>For single-turn queries, this is a single instance. For multi-turn queries, this is a repeated field that contains conversation history and the latest request.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentClientContent.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateContentClientContent.turn_complete">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">turnComplete</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Optional. If true, indicates that the server content generation should start with the currently accumulated prompt. Otherwise, the server awaits additional messages before starting generation.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput">
  <h3 id="bidigeneratecontentrealtimeinput" data-text="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput" tabindex="-1">BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput</h3>

  <section id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.description">
    <p>User input that is sent in real time.</p><p>The different modalities (audio, video and text) are handled as concurrent streams. The ordering across these streams is not guaranteed.</p><p>This is different from <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentClientContent">BidiGenerateContentClientContent</a></code> in a few ways:</p>
    <ul>
      <li>Can be sent continuously without interruption to model generation.</li>
      <li>If there is a need to mix data interleaved across the  <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentClientContent">BidiGenerateContentClientContent</a></code> and the  <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput">BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput</a></code>, the server attempts to optimize for  best response, but there are no guarantees.</li>
      <li>End of turn is not explicitly specified, but is rather derived from user  activity (for example, end of speech).</li>
      <li>Even before the end of turn, the data is processed incrementally  to optimize for a fast start of the response from the model.</li>
    </ul>
  </section>
  <section id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.repeated.Blob.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.media_chunks">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">mediaChunks[]</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#Blob">Blob</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Inlined bytes data for media input. Multiple <code translate="no" dir="ltr">mediaChunks</code> are not supported, all but the first will be ignored.</p><p>DEPRECATED: Use one of <code translate="no" dir="ltr">audio</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">video</code>, or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">text</code> instead.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.Blob.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.audio">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">audio</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#Blob">Blob</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. These form the realtime audio input stream.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.Blob.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.video">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">video</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#Blob">Blob</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. These form the realtime video input stream.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.ActivityStart.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.activity_start">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">activityStart</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.ActivityStart">ActivityStart</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Marks the start of user activity. This can only be sent if automatic (i.e. server-side) activity detection is disabled.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.ActivityEnd.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.activity_end">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">activityEnd</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.ActivityEnd">ActivityEnd</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Marks the end of user activity. This can only be sent if automatic (i.e. server-side) activity detection is disabled.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.MediaResolution.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.media_resolution">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">mediaResolution</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#MediaResolution">MediaResolution</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. The media resolution to use. If not specified, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">setup.generationConfig.mediaResolution</code> is used or a default if the setup is not provided.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.audio_stream_end">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">audioStreamEnd</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Optional. Indicates that the audio stream has ended, e.g. because the microphone was turned off.</p><p>This should only be sent when automatic activity detection is enabled (which is the default).</p><p>The client can reopen the stream by sending an audio message.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.string.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.text">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">text</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></p>
            <p>Optional. These form the realtime text input stream.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent">
  <h3 id="bidigeneratecontentservercontent" data-text="BidiGenerateContentServerContent" tabindex="-1">BidiGenerateContentServerContent</h3>

  <section id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.description">
    <p>Incremental server update generated by the model in response to client messages.</p><p>Content is generated as quickly as possible, and not in real time. Clients may choose to buffer and play it out in real time.</p><p></p>
  </section>
  <section id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.generation_complete">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">generationComplete</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Output only. If true, indicates that the model is done generating.</p><p>When model is interrupted while generating there will be no 'generation_complete' message in interrupted turn, it will go through 'interrupted &gt; turn_complete'.</p><p>When model assumes realtime playback there will be delay between generation_complete and turn_complete that is caused by model waiting for playback to finish.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.turn_complete">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">turnComplete</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Output only. If true, indicates that the model has completed its turn. Generation will only start in response to additional client messages. Note when playback status reporting is enabled, this is emitted only when the playback status indicates that the playback is done. Future playback status of the same generation will be ignored.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.interrupted">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">interrupted</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Output only. If true, indicates that a client message has interrupted current model generation. If the client is playing out the content in real time, this is a good signal to stop and empty the current playback queue.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.GroundingMetadata.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.grounding_metadata">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">groundingMetadata</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#GroundingMetadata">GroundingMetadata</a></code></p>
            <p>Output only. Grounding metadata for the generated content.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.BidiGenerateContentTranscription.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.input_transcription">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">inputTranscription</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentTranscription">BidiGenerateContentTranscription</a></code></p>
            <p>Output only. Input audio transcription. The transcription is sent independently of the other server messages and there is no guaranteed ordering.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.BidiGenerateContentTranscription.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.interim_input_transcription">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">interimInputTranscription</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentTranscription">BidiGenerateContentTranscription</a></code></p>
            <p>Output only. Low latency transcription updated while the user is speaking. This field is subject to frequent updates.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.BidiGenerateContentTranscription.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.output_transcription">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">outputTranscription</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentTranscription">BidiGenerateContentTranscription</a></code></p>
            <p>Output only. Output audio transcription. These transcriptions are part of the Generation output of the server. The last output transcription of this turn is sent before either <code translate="no" dir="ltr">generationComplete</code> or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">interrupted</code>, which in turn are followed by <code translate="no" dir="ltr">turnComplete</code>. There is no guaranteed exact ordering between transcriptions and other <code translate="no" dir="ltr">modelTurn</code> output but the server tries to send the transcripts close to the corresponding audio output.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.UrlContextMetadata.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.url_context_metadata">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">urlContextMetadata</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#UrlContextMetadata">UrlContextMetadata</a></code></p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.waiting_for_input">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">waitingForInput</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Output only. If true, indicates that the model is not generating content because it is waiting for more input from the user, e.g. because it expects the user to continue talking.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.SpeechState.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.speech_state">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">speechState<br><b>(deprecated)</b></code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentServerContent.SpeechState">SpeechState</a></code></p>
            <aside class="warning"><p>This item is deprecated!</p></aside>
            <p>Output only. DEPRECATED: Use VoiceActivity instead.</p><p>Indicates the current state of speech detection on <code translate="no" dir="ltr">realtimeInput.audio</code>. Not set or zero if the state is unchanged.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.InteractionStatus.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.interaction_status">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">interactionStatus</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentServerContent.InteractionStatus">InteractionStatus</a></code></p>
            <p>Output only. The current activity status of the live session. Always sent alongside <code translate="no" dir="ltr">turnComplete</code>.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentServerContent.FIELDS.Content.BidiGenerateContentServerContent.model_turn">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">modelTurn</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#Content">Content</a></code></p>
            <p>Output only. The content that the model has generated as part of the current conversation with the user.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="BidiGenerateContentSetup">
  <h3 id="bidigeneratecontentsetup" data-text="BidiGenerateContentSetup" tabindex="-1">BidiGenerateContentSetup</h3>

  <section id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.description">
    <p>Message to be sent in the first (and only in the first) <code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentClientMessage</code>. Contains configuration that will apply for the duration of the streaming RPC.</p><p>Clients should wait for a <code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentSetupComplete</code> message before sending any additional messages.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.string.BidiGenerateContentSetup.model">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">model</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></p>
            <p>Required. The model's resource name. This serves as an ID for the Model to use.</p><p>Format: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">models/{model}</code></p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.GenerationConfig.BidiGenerateContentSetup.generation_config">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">generationConfig</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#GenerationConfig">GenerationConfig</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Generation config.</p><p>The following fields are not supported:</p>
            <ul>
              <li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">responseLogprobs</code></li>
              <li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">responseMimeType</code></li>
              <li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">logprobs</code></li>
              <li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">responseSchema</code></li>
              <li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">responseJsonSchema</code></li>
              <li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">stopSequence</code></li>
              <li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">skipResponseCache</code></li>
              <li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">routingConfig</code></li>
              <li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">audioTimestamp</code></li>
            </ul>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.Content.BidiGenerateContentSetup.system_instruction">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">systemInstruction</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#Content">Content</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. The user provided system instructions for the model.</p><p>Note: Only text should be used in parts and content in each part will be in a separate paragraph.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.repeated.Tool.BidiGenerateContentSetup.tools">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">tools[]</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#Tool">Tool</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. A list of <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Tools</code> the model may use to generate the next response.</p><p>A <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Tool</code> is a piece of code that enables the system to interact with external systems to perform an action, or set of actions, outside of knowledge and scope of the model.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.RealtimeInputConfig.BidiGenerateContentSetup.realtime_input_config">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">realtimeInputConfig</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#RealtimeInputConfig">RealtimeInputConfig</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Configures the handling of realtime input.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.SessionResumptionConfig.BidiGenerateContentSetup.session_resumption">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">sessionResumption</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#SessionResumptionConfig">SessionResumptionConfig</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Configures session resumption mechanism.</p><p>If included, the server will send <code translate="no" dir="ltr">SessionResumptionUpdate</code> messages.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.ContextWindowCompressionConfig.BidiGenerateContentSetup.context_window_compression">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">contextWindowCompression</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#ContextWindowCompressionConfig">ContextWindowCompressionConfig</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Configures a context window compression mechanism.</p><p>If included, the server will automatically reduce the size of the context when it exceeds the configured length.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.AudioTranscriptionConfig.BidiGenerateContentSetup.input_audio_transcription">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">inputAudioTranscription</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#AudioTranscriptionConfig">AudioTranscriptionConfig</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. If set, enables transcription of voice input. The transcription aligns with the input audio language, if configured.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.AudioTranscriptionConfig.BidiGenerateContentSetup.output_audio_transcription">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">outputAudioTranscription</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#AudioTranscriptionConfig">AudioTranscriptionConfig</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. If set, enables transcription of the model's audio output. The transcription aligns with the language code specified for the output audio, if configured.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.ProactivityConfig.BidiGenerateContentSetup.proactivity">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">proactivity</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#ProactivityConfig">ProactivityConfig</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Configures the proactivity of the model.</p><p>This allows the model to respond proactively to the input and to ignore irrelevant input.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="BidiGenerateContentSetup.FIELDS.HistoryConfig.BidiGenerateContentSetup.history_config">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">historyConfig</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#HistoryConfig">HistoryConfig</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Configures the exchange of history between the client and the server.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="BidiGenerateContentToolCallCancellation">
  <h3 id="bidigeneratecontenttoolcallcancellation" data-text="BidiGenerateContentToolCallCancellation" tabindex="-1">BidiGenerateContentToolCallCancellation</h3>

  <section id="BidiGenerateContentToolCallCancellation.description">
    <p>Notification for the client that a previously issued <code translate="no" dir="ltr">ToolCallMessage</code> with the specified <code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code>s should not have been executed and should be cancelled. If there were side-effects to those tool calls, clients may attempt to undo the tool calls. This message occurs only in cases where the clients interrupt server turns.</p>
  </section>

            <p>Output only. The ids of the tool calls to be cancelled.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>

    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="BidiGenerateContentToolResponse">

    <p>Client generated response to a <code translate="no" dir="ltr">ToolCall</code> received from the server. Individual <code translate="no" dir="ltr">FunctionResponse</code> objects are matched to the respective <code translate="no" dir="ltr">FunctionCall</code> objects by the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code> field.</p><p>Note that in the unary and server-streaming GenerateContent APIs function calling happens by exchanging the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Content</code> parts, while in the bidi GenerateContent APIs function calling happens over these dedicated set of messages.</p>
  </section>

<section id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig">
  <h3 id="contextwindowcompressionconfig" data-text="ContextWindowCompressionConfig" tabindex="-1">ContextWindowCompressionConfig</h3>

  <section id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.description">
    <p>Enables context window compression — a mechanism for managing the model's context window so that it does not exceed a given length.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.FIELDS.oneof_compression_mechanism" class="alt">
          <td colspan="2">Union field <code translate="no" dir="ltr">compressionMechanism</code>. The context window compression mechanism used. <code translate="no" dir="ltr">compressionMechanism</code> can be only one of the following:</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.FIELDS.ContextWindowCompressionConfig.SlidingWindow.ContextWindowCompressionConfig.sliding_window">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">slidingWindow</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#ContextWindowCompressionConfig.SlidingWindow">SlidingWindow</a></code></p>
            <p>A sliding-window mechanism.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.FIELDS.int64.ContextWindowCompressionConfig.trigger_tokens">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">triggerTokens</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">int64</code></p>
            <p>The number of tokens (before running a turn) required to trigger a context window compression.</p><p>This can be used to balance quality against latency as shorter context windows may result in faster model responses. However, any compression operation will cause a temporary latency increase, so they should not be triggered frequently.</p><p>If not set, the default is 80% of the model's context window limit. This leaves 20% for the next user request/model response.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="HistoryConfig">

  </section>

          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Optional. If true, after sending <code translate="no" dir="ltr">setupComplete</code>, the server will wait and at first process <code translate="no" dir="ltr">clientContent</code> messages until <code translate="no" dir="ltr">turnComplete</code> is <code translate="no" dir="ltr">true</code>. This initial history will not trigger a model call and may end with role <code translate="no" dir="ltr">MODEL</code>. After <code translate="no" dir="ltr">turnComplete</code> is <code translate="no" dir="ltr">true</code>, the client can start the realtime conversation via <code translate="no" dir="ltr">realtimeInput</code>.</p>

<section id="SessionResumptionUpdate">

  <section id="SessionResumptionUpdate.description">
    <p>Update of the session resumption state.</p><p>Only sent if <code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentSetup.sessionResumption</code> was set.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="SessionResumptionUpdate.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="SessionResumptionUpdate.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="SessionResumptionUpdate.FIELDS.string.SessionResumptionUpdate.new_handle">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">newHandle</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></p>
            <p>New handle that represents a state that can be resumed. Empty if <code translate="no" dir="ltr">resumable</code>=false.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="SessionResumptionUpdate.FIELDS.bool.SessionResumptionUpdate.resumable">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">resumable</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>True if the current session can be resumed at this point.</p><p>Resumption is not possible at some points in the session. For example, when the model is executing function calls or generating. Resuming the session (using a previous session token) in such a state will result in some data loss. In these cases, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">newHandle</code> will be empty and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">resumable</code> will be false.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

</section>

<section id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.SlidingWindow">
  <h3 id="slidingwindow" data-text="SlidingWindow" tabindex="-1">SlidingWindow</h3>

  <section id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.SlidingWindow.description">
    <p>The SlidingWindow method operates by discarding content at the beginning of the context window. The resulting context will always begin at the start of a USER role turn. System instructions and any <code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentSetup.prefixTurns</code> will always remain at the beginning of the result.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.SlidingWindow.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.SlidingWindow.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="ContextWindowCompressionConfig.SlidingWindow.FIELDS.int64.ContextWindowCompressionConfig.SlidingWindow.target_tokens">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">targetTokens</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">int64</code></p>
            <p>The target number of tokens to keep. The default value is trigger_tokens/2.</p><p>Discarding parts of the context window causes a temporary latency increase so this value should be calibrated to avoid frequent compression operations.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity">
  <h3 id="startsensitivity" data-text="StartSensitivity" tabindex="-1">StartSensitivity</h3>

  <section id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity.description">
    <p>Determines how start of speech is detected.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity.ENUM_VALUES">
    <table class="constants responsive fixed" id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity.ENUM_VALUES-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Enums</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity.ENUM_VALUES.RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity.START_SENSITIVITY_UNSPECIFIED">
          <td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">START_SENSITIVITY_UNSPECIFIED</code></td>
          <td>The default is START_SENSITIVITY_HIGH.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity.ENUM_VALUES.RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity.START_SENSITIVITY_HIGH">
          <td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">START_SENSITIVITY_HIGH</code></td>
          <td>Automatic detection will detect the start of speech more often.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity.ENUM_VALUES.RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection.StartSensitivity.START_SENSITIVITY_LOW">
          <td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">START_SENSITIVITY_LOW</code></td>
          <td>Automatic detection will detect the start of speech less often.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage">
  <h3 id="turncoverage" data-text="TurnCoverage" tabindex="-1">TurnCoverage</h3>

  <section id="RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.description">
    <p>Options about which input is included in the user's turn.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.ENUM_VALUES">
    <table class="constants responsive fixed" id="RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.ENUM_VALUES-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Enums</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.ENUM_VALUES.RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.TURN_COVERAGE_UNSPECIFIED">
          <td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">TURN_COVERAGE_UNSPECIFIED</code></td>
          <td>If unspecified, a default behavior is selected based on the model. E.g., for Gemini 2.5, the default is <code translate="no" dir="ltr">TURN_INCLUDES_ONLY_ACTIVITY</code>, while for Gemini 3.1 and onwards, it's <code translate="no" dir="ltr">TURN_INCLUDES_AUDIO_ACTIVITY_AND_ALL_VIDEO</code>.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.ENUM_VALUES.RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.TURN_INCLUDES_ONLY_ACTIVITY">
          <td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">TURN_INCLUDES_ONLY_ACTIVITY</code></td>
          <td>Includes activity since the last turn, excluding inactivity (e.g. silence on the audio stream).</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.ENUM_VALUES.RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.TURN_INCLUDES_ALL_INPUT">
          <td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">TURN_INCLUDES_ALL_INPUT</code></td>
          <td>Includes all realtime input since the last turn, including inactivity (e.g. silence on the audio stream).</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.ENUM_VALUES.RealtimeInputConfig.TurnCoverage.TURN_INCLUDES_AUDIO_ACTIVITY_AND_ALL_VIDEO">
          <td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">TURN_INCLUDES_AUDIO_ACTIVITY_AND_ALL_VIDEO</code></td>
          <td>Includes audio activity and all video since the last turn. With automatic activity detection, audio activity means speech and excludes silence.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="TranslationConfig.FIELDS.bool.TranslationConfig.echo_target_language">

<h2 id="ephemeral-auth-tokens" data-text="Ephemeral authentication tokens" tabindex="-1">Ephemeral authentication tokens</h2>

<p>Ephemeral authentication tokens can be obtained by calling
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">AuthTokenService.CreateToken</code> and then used with
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContentConstrained</code>, either by passing the token
in an <code translate="no" dir="ltr">access_token</code> query parameter, or in an HTTP <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Authorization</code> header with
&quot;<code translate="no" dir="ltr">Token</code>&quot; prefixed to it.</p>

<section id="CreateAuthTokenRequest">
  <h3 id="createauthtokenrequest" data-text="CreateAuthTokenRequest" tabindex="-1">CreateAuthTokenRequest</h3>

    </table>

</section>

<section id="AuthToken">
  <h3 id="authtoken" data-text="AuthToken" tabindex="-1">AuthToken</h3>

  <section id="AuthToken.description">
    <p>A request to create an ephemeral authentication token.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="AuthToken.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="AuthToken.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%">
        <col>
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="AuthToken.FIELDS.string.AuthToken.name">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">name</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></p>
            <p>Output only. Identifier. The token itself.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AuthToken.FIELDS.google.protobuf.Timestamp.AuthToken.expire_time">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">expireTime</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp">Timestamp</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. An optional time after which, when using the resulting token, messages in BidiGenerateContent sessions will be rejected. (Gemini may preemptively close the session after this time.)</p><p>If not set then this defaults to 30 minutes in the future. If set, this value must be less than 20 hours in the future.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AuthToken.FIELDS.google.protobuf.Timestamp.AuthToken.new_session_expire_time">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">newSessionExpireTime</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp">Timestamp</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. The time after which new Live API sessions using the token resulting from this request will be rejected.</p><p>If not set this defaults to 60 seconds in the future. If set, this value must be less than 20 hours in the future.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AuthToken.FIELDS.google.protobuf.FieldMask.AuthToken.field_mask">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">fieldMask</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#field-mask">FieldMask</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. If field_mask is empty, and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">bidiGenerateContentSetup</code> is not present, then the effective <code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentSetup</code> message is taken from the Live API connection.</p><p>If field_mask is empty, and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">bidiGenerateContentSetup</code> <em>is</em> present, then the effective <code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentSetup</code> message is taken entirely from <code translate="no" dir="ltr">bidiGenerateContentSetup</code> in this request. The setup message from the Live API connection is ignored.</p><p>If field_mask is not empty, then the corresponding fields from <code translate="no" dir="ltr">bidiGenerateContentSetup</code> will overwrite the fields from the setup message in the Live API connection.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AuthToken.FIELDS.oneof_config" class="alt">
          <td colspan="2">Union field <code translate="no" dir="ltr">config</code>. The method-specific configuration for the resulting token. <code translate="no" dir="ltr">config</code> can be only one of the following:</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AuthToken.FIELDS.BidiGenerateContentSetup.AuthToken.bidi_generate_content_setup">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">bidiGenerateContentSetup</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateContentSetup">BidiGenerateContentSetup</a></code></p>
            <p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. Configuration specific to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContent</code>.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AuthToken.FIELDS.int32.AuthToken.uses">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">uses</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">int32</code></p>
            <p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. The number of times the token can be used. If this value is zero then no limit is applied. Resuming a Live API session does not count as a use. If unspecified, the default is 1.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>
